<thought>To locate a suitable Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the functional groups that are formed in the forward reaction, which are available in the system: “aliphatic carboxylic acid” and “C‑C double bonds”. This should return templates that generate an acid and a C=C bond, matching the HWE transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
